foodie.title: Michelin-Starred Tasting Menu at DiverXO
foodie.description: Sit down for chef Dabiz Muñoz's theatrical, three-Michelin-starred tasting menu of avant-garde Asian-Spanish fusion.
foodie.bonus: Photograph the most unexpected plate of the night.

foodie.title: Dinner at Botín, the World's Oldest Restaurant
foodie.description: Feast on wood-fired roast suckling pig inside the Guinness-certified oldest restaurant in the world, open since 1725.
foodie.bonus: Ask to see the centuries-old wood oven.

foodie.title: Tasting Menu at Triciclo
foodie.description: Work through a multi-course tasting menu of modern Spanish plates at this acclaimed La Latina bistro.
foodie.bonus: Let the sommelier pick your wine pairing.

foodie.title: Tapas Crawl Through Cava Baja
foodie.description: Hop between packed taverns on La Latina's Calle Cava Baja, ordering a different pintxo and wine at each stop.
foodie.bonus: Order something you've never tried before.

foodie.title: Craft Beer Flight at Fábrica Maravillas
foodie.description: Sample a flight of house-brewed IPAs and stouts at Malasaña's buzzing microbrewery and taproom.
foodie.bonus: Rank the flight from favorite to least favorite out loud.

foodie.title: Bocadillo de Calamares Near Plaza Mayor
foodie.description: Bite into a crusty roll stuffed with fried squid rings, a Madrid classic best eaten standing at the counter.
foodie.bonus: Add a squeeze of lemon before the first bite.

foodie.title: Food Hall Crawl at Mercado de San Antón
foodie.description: Climb through three floors of gourmet stalls and a rooftop terrace at Chueca's stylish Mercado de San Antón.
foodie.bonus: Eat dinner standing up at three different stalls.

foodie.title: Sunday Vermouth Hour at Casa Alberto
foodie.description: Sip a chilled glass of house vermouth with a plate of olives at one of Madrid's oldest classic tabernas.
foodie.bonus: Ask the bartender for their personal recommendation.

foodie.title: Cocido Madrileño at Taberna La Bola
foodie.description: Spoon into a slow-simmered three-course chickpea and meat stew at a taberna that's served it since 1870.
foodie.bonus: Finish every course, broth to meat.

foodie.title: Tapas and Wine at Mercado San Miguel
foodie.description: Graze stall to stall inside the glass-walled Mercado San Miguel, pairing jamón and croquetas with a crisp cava.
foodie.bonus: Try a tapa you can't pronounce.

foodie.title: Guided Wine Tasting at Lavinia Madrid
foodie.description: Taste a curated flight of Spanish reds and whites guided by a sommelier at one of Europe's largest wine shops.
foodie.bonus: Pick a bottle to take home based on the label alone.

foodie.title: Chocolate con Churros at San Ginés
foodie.description: Dunk fresh-fried churros into thick hot chocolate at the century-old Chocolatería San Ginés near Puerta del Sol.
foodie.bonus: Go at 2am like a true Madrileño night owl.

adventure.title: Escape Room Showdown in Malasaña
adventure.description: Race the clock cracking codes and hidden locks inside a themed escape room in the heart of Malasaña.
adventure.bonus: Solve the final puzzle without asking for a hint.

adventure.title: Sunrise Yoga Session in Retiro Park
adventure.description: Flow through a sun salutation sequence on the grass as El Retiro wakes up around you.
adventure.bonus: Hold your hardest pose for ten extra seconds.

adventure.title: Santiago Bernabéu Stadium Tour
adventure.description: Walk the players' tunnel, trophy room, and pitch-side seats on a self-guided tour of Real Madrid's home stadium.
adventure.bonus: Touch the trophy replica in the museum.

adventure.title: Outdoor Lap Swim at Piscina Canal
adventure.description: Cut laps through Madrid's iconic outdoor municipal pool complex, a summer institution since the 1970s.
adventure.bonus: Swim ten laps without stopping.

adventure.title: Karting Showdown at Karting Madrid
adventure.description: Floor it around a professional go-kart circuit just outside the city, chasing the fastest lap of the day.
adventure.bonus: Bet the loser buys the next round.

adventure.title: Guided Bike Tour of Historic Madrid
adventure.description: Pedal a guided route past the Royal Palace, Gran Vía, and hidden plazas with a local cycling guide.
adventure.bonus: Ask the guide for their favorite hidden spot in the city.

adventure.title: Indoor Climbing Session at Indoorwall Madrid
adventure.description: Chalk up and work your way up bouldering walls and roped routes at one of Madrid's top indoor climbing gyms.
adventure.bonus: Send a route harder than your usual grade.

adventure.title: Segway Tour Through Historic Madrid
adventure.description: Glide past Plaza Mayor, Puerta del Sol, and the Royal Palace on a guided Segway loop through the old quarter.
adventure.bonus: Learn one historical fact you didn't know about Madrid.

adventure.title: Padel Match at a Local Club
adventure.description: Book a court and rally through a fast-paced game of padel, the racquet sport Madrid can't get enough of.
adventure.bonus: Play a full set, win or lose.

adventure.title: Rollerblading the Trails of Casa de Campo
adventure.description: Skate miles of paved trails through Madrid's largest park, weaving past pine forest and lake views.
adventure.bonus: Skate to the lake and back without a break.

adventure.title: Sunrise Run Around the Retiro Lake
adventure.description: Log an early loop past fountains and monuments while El Retiro is still quiet and golden with morning light.
adventure.bonus: Beat yesterday's pace for the same loop.

adventure.title: Day Trip to El Escorial Monastery
adventure.description: Wander the austere halls, royal crypts, and gardens of Felipe II's monumental monastery-palace outside Madrid.
adventure.bonus: Find the library's ceiling fresco and name three subjects painted on it.

adventure.title: Rowboating on the Retiro Park Lake
adventure.description: Paddle a rented rowboat past the Alfonso XII monument while street musicians play along the shore.
adventure.bonus: Race another boat to the far end of the lake.

adventure.title: Tandem Paragliding Flight Near Madrid
adventure.description: Launch off a mountainside near the capital and soar over the countryside strapped to an instructor's harness.
adventure.bonus: Film the landing on your phone.

adventure.title: Sunset Hike up Cerro del Tío Pío
adventure.description: Climb the terraced hillside of Cerro del Tío Pío, Madrid's 'Seven Tits Park,' for a wraparound skyline sunset.
adventure.bonus: Take a panoramic photo from the top step.

adventure.title: Full-Day Escape to Toledo's Old Town
adventure.description: Wind through medieval alleys, climb the cathedral tower, and taste marzipan in Spain's former imperial capital.
adventure.bonus: Buy a piece of authentic Toledo steel or damascened jewelry.

adventure.title: Cable Car Ride Over Casa de Campo
adventure.description: Glide 2.5 km above pine forest and the Manzanares river in a swaying gondola bound for Casa de Campo.
adventure.bonus: Snap a photo of the skyline from the highest point.

adventure.title: Bike Ride Along Madrid Río
adventure.description: Pedal the flat, shaded paths along the Manzanares river through Madrid Río's parks, bridges, and fountains.
adventure.bonus: Ride the full stretch without stopping.

adventure.title: Pickup Football Match at La Elipa
adventure.description: Join a pickup soccer game on public pitches at Polideportivo La Elipa, Madrid's beloved neighborhood sports complex.
adventure.bonus: Score at least one goal.

adventure.title: Thrill Rides at Parque de Atracciones
adventure.description: Chase adrenaline on roller coasters and drop towers at Madrid's classic amusement park in Casa de Campo.
adventure.bonus: Ride the scariest coaster twice in a row.

adventure.title: Sunrise Hike Through La Pedriza
adventure.description: Scramble over granite boulders and pine trails in Sierra de Guadarrama's dramatic La Pedriza nature park.
adventure.bonus: Reach a summit and eat breakfast with the view.

adventure.title: Full Day at Parque Warner Madrid
adventure.description: Spend the day looping through movie-themed roller coasters and stunt shows at Madrid's Warner Bros theme park.
adventure.bonus: Ride the park's biggest coaster front row.

social.title: Salsa Night at Café Berlín
social.description: Sway through salsa and bachata sets with a packed dance floor at this classic live-music venue near Sol.
social.bonus: Ask someone you don't know to dance.

social.title: Dancing Until Dawn at Kapital
social.description: Move through seven floors of music, from reggaeton to house, inside Madrid's legendary mega-nightclub.
social.bonus: Dance on a different floor every hour.

social.title: Real Madrid Match at Santiago Bernabéu
social.description: Roar alongside 80,000 fans as Real Madrid takes the pitch inside the newly renovated Santiago Bernabéu Stadium.
social.bonus: Learn the chant and sing along.

social.title: Karaoke Night at El Rincón del Arte Nuevo
social.description: Grab the mic and belt out a classic at one of Madrid's most beloved late-night karaoke bars.
social.bonus: Sing a song entirely in Spanish.

social.title: Bar Hopping Through Malasaña
social.description: Bounce between vintage-cool bars and hidden speakeasies along Malasaña's buzzing nightlife grid.
social.bonus: Talk to a stranger at the bar.

social.title: Flamenco Show at Cardamomo Tablao
social.description: Feel the stomp and wail of live flamenco up close at one of Madrid's most intimate traditional tablaos.
social.bonus: Clap along on the offbeat like the locals.

social.title: Rooftop Drinks at Círculo de Bellas Artes
social.description: Ride the elevator to Madrid's most iconic rooftop terrace for cocktails with a 360-degree skyline view.
social.bonus: Toast to something you're grateful for.

social.title: Bar Crawl Through Chueca's Nightlife
social.description: Move through Chueca's colorful, high-energy bars, the beating heart of Madrid's LGBTQ+ scene.
social.bonus: Buy a round for the group next to you.

social.title: Gin and Tonic Crawl in Chamberí
social.description: Sample elaborate, garnish-heavy gin and tonics at a string of stylish bars through the leafy Chamberí district.
social.bonus: Order the most unusual gin on the menu.

social.title: Language Exchange Meetup at Plaza de Santa Ana
social.description: Trade half-Spanish, half-English conversation with locals and travelers at a lively language exchange meetup.
social.bonus: Have one full conversation only in Spanish.

social.title: Dinner and Flamenco at Corral de la Morería
social.description: Savor a tasting menu before world-class dancers erupt into flamenco at this Michelin-starred, decades-old tablao.
social.bonus: Applaud loudly after the guitarist's solo.

social.title: Pub Trivia Night at The Irish Rover
social.description: Team up with strangers over pints for a rowdy pub quiz night at one of Madrid's favorite Irish bars.
social.bonus: Answer at least one question with a total guess.

chill.title: Quiet Afternoon in the Retiro Rosaleda
chill.description: Wander rows of blooming roses in El Retiro's hidden rose garden, a quiet pocket away from the crowds.
chill.bonus: Find the rarest-looking bloom in the garden.

chill.title: Rooftop Sunset Cocktail at Hotel Emperador
chill.description: Sip a cocktail beside the rooftop pool of Hotel Emperador with Gran Vía's rooftops glowing at golden hour.
chill.bonus: Order the bartender's personal favorite drink.

chill.title: Hammam Ritual at AIRE Ancient Baths
chill.description: Drift between candlelit thermal pools, steam rooms, and a massage inside a restored 17th-century palace basement.
chill.bonus: Stay silent through the entire bath circuit.

chill.title: Sunset at Templo de Debod
chill.description: Watch the sky turn gold behind an authentic 2,200-year-old Egyptian temple gifted to Madrid, overlooking the city.
chill.bonus: Stay until the last light fades.

chill.title: Masterpieces at the Prado Museum
chill.description: Stand before Velázquez's Las Meninas and Goya's Black Paintings inside one of the world's greatest art museums.
chill.bonus: Find your favorite painting and explain why.

chill.title: Picnic Stroll Around the Retiro Lake
chill.description: Spread a blanket near the Estanque Grande and watch rowboats drift by under El Retiro's shady trees.
chill.bonus: Bring a snack you've never had before.

chill.title: Sunset Views from Faro de Moncloa
chill.description: Ride the glass elevator up a 92-meter communications tower for a 360-degree sunset panorama of Madrid.
chill.bonus: Spot three landmarks from the observation deck.

chill.title: Palacio de Cristal Art Viewing
chill.description: Step inside El Retiro's glass-and-iron greenhouse-turned-gallery, filled with natural light and rotating installations.
chill.bonus: Take a photo through the glass ceiling.

chill.title: Art Hour at the Thyssen-Bornemisza
chill.description: Move through eight centuries of European painting in one of the world's finest private art collections turned museum.
chill.bonus: Pick the single most surprising piece on display.

chill.title: Sunday Browse at El Rastro Flea Market
chill.description: Wander hundreds of stalls of antiques, vinyl, and vintage finds through Madrid's centuries-old Sunday flea market.
chill.bonus: Haggle the price down on one item.

chill.title: Coffee and People-Watching at Plaza Mayor
chill.description: Nurse a café con leche at an outdoor table and watch street performers work the grand arcaded square.
chill.bonus: Guess where three passersby are from.

chill.title: See Guernica at Museo Reina Sofía
chill.description: Face Picasso's monumental anti-war mural Guernica in person inside Madrid's modern art museum.
chill.bonus: Sit with the painting for five full minutes.
